docs.title: Welcome to em_inspection
docs.text: em_inspection is a specialized Python toolkit for interactive inspection, alignment verification, and coarse-offset calculations for Serial Block-Face Electron Microscopy (SBEM) datasets.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Parser for SBEM Datasets: Standardized file structures, metadata, and section indexing.
  • Interactive Inspection: Dashboard UI for reviewing tile overlaps and outlier regions.
  • Quality Control: Automated coarse offset calculation, error metrics, and mask generation.

For installation steps, see the Installation Guide.

docs.title: Using Pixi (Recommended)
docs.text:
em_inspection uses Pixi to manage Python and C++ dependencies reproducibly.

  1. Install Pixi: bash curl -fsSL https://pixi.sh/install.sh | bash

  2. Clone and set up environment: bash git clone https://github.com/ganctom/em_inspection.git cd em_inspection pixi install

  3. Run tasks: bash pixi run test
